The IBM Intel X710-DA2 (Part Number: 01DA902) is a dual-port 10GbE SFP+ network adapter, designed for high-throughput, low-latency networking in enterprise environments. Powered by the Intel X710 chipset, this PCI Express Gen3 x8 card delivers reliable and efficient performance for cloud, virtualization, storage, and server applications.

With two SFP+ ports, the X710-DA2 supports both optical transceivers and direct attach cables (DAC), providing flexibility for various 10GbE networking setups. It includes support for SR-IOV, iSCSI, PXE Boot, and advanced virtualization and load balancing features, making it ideal for modern data centers and high-density environments.

Key Features:

  • Model: X710-DA2

  • IBM PN: 01DA902

  • Chipset: Intel X710

  • Interface: PCI Express Gen3 x8

  • Ports: 2 x 10GbE SFP+

  • Speed: Up to 10 Gbps per port (20 Gbps total)

  • Cabling: Supports fiber optics or SFP+ DAC

  • Form Factor: Low-profile and full-height brackets included

  • Advanced Features:

    • SR-IOV support

    • Jumbo Frames

    • PXE and iSCSI Boot

    • VLAN and QoS support

    • DPDK, VXLAN, NVGRE Offloading

    • IEEE 802.1q, 802.3az, 802.1p

Compatible With:

  • IBM System x and Lenovo ThinkSystem Servers

  • Other standard PCIe x8/x16 motherboards

  • Windows, Linux, VMware ESXi, and more

Ideal For:

  • High-Speed Server Networking

  • Data Centers & Virtualization

  • iSCSI SAN Environments

  • Enterprise Cloud Infrastructure
